notes:
### Timed Manual Stop Fix

- Timed One Channel checks now distinguish an explicit user Stop from an internal recovery loss. A manual Stop ends the running check instead of entering the Check Lock restore loop and repeatedly reopening Dorcel TV.
- Existing EOF/error and internal recovery protection remain available for genuine lost-player cases.

### Recovery Curtain Extension

- The existing black handoff curtain now also covers validated Dorcel source-recovery / website-down handoffs, so Kodi's skin is hidden during those controlled PVR_COM / PVR_COM_SITE reopen transitions as well as expiry handoffs.
- The proven v1.155/v1.156 expiry, standby, timeline and PVR recovery logic remains unchanged.

### Streaming Stability

- Normal SOURCE_WINDOW stalls, background standby timing, expiry thresholds, live delay and provider-outage handling are unchanged.
- No speculative buffering tweak was added for the short unstable test run, because that log contained DNS/name-resolution failures and no executed expiry handoff before the buffering began.
- No local HLS proxy/fallback is introduced.

### Important

- The existing expiry-aware planned refresh remains enabled.
- The 2 h Stop / Unlimited / Timeout behavior from v1.156 remains unchanged.
